cases.name: Syibrieka Underwood
cases.about: Her mother Jackie Underwood said, "My daughter Syibrieka was a wonderful young lady, my baby was everything, my baby was my friend."
cases.narrative: A state trooper found her body in her car in Duncanville along the roadside of Highway 82 after he allegedly shot and killed her in her car and left her body there.
